## Summary

Describe the operational problem and the outcome of this change.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Security or policy control
- [ ] Connector or integration
- [ ] Documentation

## Safety review

- [ ] Mock execution remains the default
- [ ] New operations are explicitly allowlisted
- [ ] Approval requirements cannot be overridden by model output
- [ ] No secrets, production identifiers, or personal data are included
- [ ] Failure, retry, and idempotency behavior was considered

## Validation

- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] `make check` passes locally
- [ ] Documentation and changelog updated where needed
